properties.rationale: The owner asked for the page to start with the setup he uses at home, the one he uses at work, and the one a team server needs, with no person named. Setup pages are hand-written under dec:the-sites-setup-pages-are-hand-written-and-its-design-pages-stay-generated; everything describing the design stays generated.
